stable.notes: Fixes internal command-output blocking that could misidentify a healthy managed server and prevent updates. notice.title: Ask your knowledge
notice.body: Ask the graph now comes first, with a preloaded graph and optional Advanced investigation controls. Memories follows your Mac appearance. Update Server to 6.45.1 for editable owner identity and accurate retained-capture states.
